countedBy: lane #210 (opus) from the rectified panorama crops w05-75 (TMX7316010203-002620_pano_0007_000079, 2022-06-22), w06-77 (b_20241211_1256_Track10_Sphere_00075, 2024-12-11) and w07-75 (b_20241211_1256_Track10_Sphere_00055, 2024-12-11), about 50 px/m; ribbon convention (a shop front counts once); awnings, signs and lamp posts are not openings. The framed-bay front (w04) is left uncounted: its two-storey steel frames hold glazing that does not split into storey rows cleanly. alongM is measured from the elevation's viewer-left (south) end: the south wedge starts 0.9 m in, the north wedge at 69.4 m, the north block at 103.8 m.

facades.name: North punched wedge, Westerdokskade front
facades.note: Ground storey: four glazed shop fronts between brick piers. Five storeys of eight deep-set windows on one grid; the top row has the same windows (two awnings on the first floor are not openings). The tower roof at viewer-left is behind the parapet. Axes: the eight window columns plus the four shop-front centres, which fall between window pairs. The crop reads about 10% short vertically against the 3DBAG parapet (23 m); heightM follows 3DBAG.

facades.name: South punched wedge, Westerdokskade front
facades.note: Same grid as the north wedge: four shop fronts, five storeys of eight deep-set windows. The lamp post and the road sign stand in front. Axes: eight window columns plus four shop-front centres.

facades.name: North block, Westerdokskade end
facades.note: Ground storey: three glazed shop fronts (the right two under the deck canopy). Five storeys of six French windows with railings; the first floor's right four open onto the deck's long railing. The crop stops at the corner pier on the right. Axes: six window columns plus three shop-front centres between window pairs.
